description: Zombie pigman anger spreading. Four adult zombie pigmen are summoned around a survival operator (offsets in blocks from the player's feet); the player hurts A with `/damage @e[type=zombie_pigman,name=A] 1 entity_attack entity @s`. `targets_attacker` and `angry` say whether the pigman's TARGET actor data became the player and its ANGRY actor flag was set; all changes happened within two ticks of the hit and lasted until the player turned creative 51 s later (a second hit 16.6 s after the first changed nothing). The pigman's `minecraft:angry` has broadcast_anger, broadcast_range 20, duration 25. `calm` is a second run: pigmen A and B (offsets [4,0,0] and [4,0,6]) fight the player for 4.5 s after A is hurt, then the player turns creative and both drop it; each pigman cleared ANGRY 24.95 s after its own last StartAttacking swing (the swings did no damage: the player had full resistance), not 25 s after the anger started or after the target was dropped.
server: BDS 1.26.51 (plain bedrock_server, no Endstone), seed 12345 harness world, difficulty normal, midnight

source.capture: tools/bds-sweep/capture.py --commands, 2026-11-10 (ent-calm-jockey-20261110); the client stopped on a later oversized batch, so the calm run was decoded from the per-record operator-commands/packets.jsonl

calm.times: seconds after the hit, from packet timestamps (±1 tick)
